out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the base of both the FRONT and REAR DOORS.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO SEAL UP THE GAPS ALONG THE BASES OF BOTH THE FRONT AND REAR DOORS USING DOOR SWEEPS TO PREVENT POSSIBLE INSECT/RODENT ENTRY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved splitter device on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS HAD THE MANAGER TAKE A PICTURE OF THE PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE. MANAGER WAS INSTRUCTED TO ORDER IT TODAY AND REMOVE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER AND ONLY CONNECT ONE HOSE TO THE MOP SINK.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the FRONT SERVICE LINE HAND SINK EQUIPMENT is leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EHS WAS INFORMED BY MANAGEMENT THAT A WORK ORDER WAS SUBMITTED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed some ceiling panels not maintained in good repair. Small gaps/holes were observed where electrical wiring, plumbing, etc were located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO SEAL UP THE GAPS/HOLES TO PREVENT POSSIBLE INSECT ENTRY. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Dressing Rooms/Lockers, Designated
violations.observation: Employees are not using the dressing rooms or lockers provided. Observed employees personal belongings (e.g. back pack and purse) stored on shelving with equipment, food, and/or single service items.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated dressing rooms to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO MOVE THE PERSONAL BELONGINGS TO THE LOCKERS PROVIDED.
